summary: Action Required: Network Plugin Migration Blocked
description: Your cluster is unable to initiate its live network plugin migration because the following pod(s) have an unsupported egress router pod annotation: ${PODS}. Please delete these pods or remove their `pod.network.openshift.io/assign-macvlan` annotations. Refer to the following OpenShift Dedicated documentation for further details: https://docs.redhat.com/en/documentation/openshift_dedicated/4/html/networking/ovn-kubernetes-network-plugin#migrate-sdn-ovn-ocm-cli_migrate-from-openshift-sdn-osd.
